name: Guardian OOD (UR5-Fail / RoboFail / RoboVQA)
summary: 执行前后的多视角图像配有子任务成功/失败与失败类别标注。
summaryEn: Multi-view images before and after execution carry subtask success/failure and failure-category labels.
scale: 650 execution examples; 170 planning cases are separately bundled
scaleZh: 650 个执行样例；另附 170 个规划案例
license: Card states Apache-2.0; original RoboFail and RoboVQA terms also apply
licenseZh: 数据卡声明 Apache-2.0；原始 RoboFail 与 RoboVQA 条款另行适用
access: Official documentation or implementation; data download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档或实现入口；未进行数据下载测试
wmNote: 收录限定带起止图像与执行结果的 OOD 子集，不是完整视频轨迹。另附单张初始图像的规划案例，不能据此声称有时序转移。与 FailCoT 训练数据分开。
wmNoteEn: Scope is the OOD execution subset with start/end images and outcome labels, not full video trajectories. Separately bundled single-image planning cases do not establish temporal transitions. Distinct from FailCoT training data.

evidence.statement: The OOD execution subsets provide start/end subtask images paired with success/failure outcomes: UR5-Fail 140, RoboFail 153 and RoboVQA 357 examples. Separately bundled single-image planning cases are not the qualifying temporal evidence.
